tools.name: find_nearest_toilets
tools.description: Find the public toilets nearest to a set of coordinates, using data from the National Public Toilet Map. Useful for finding the closest toilet, the closest accessible toilet or the nearest RV dump point. Returns toilets sorted by distance, each with name, address, distance, opening hours, facilities

tools.name: search_campsites
tools.description:
Search campsites, caravan parks, free camps and other accommodation by place name, region, state, map coordinates, listing type and features. Returns matching listings with name, location, rating, features and images.

Coverage: Australia (the default), the United States (federal, BLM and national-f

tools.name: get_campsite_details
tools.description: Get the full record for one campsite or accommodation listing by its entity_id (from search_campsites results). Returns the description, all features and amenities, address, photos, rating, accommodation types offered and booking information. Inactive listings are not returned.

tools.name: get_regions
tools.description: List camping and accommodation regions with the number of listings in each, optionally filtered by state. Useful for browsing by area when there is no specific destination yet.

tools.name: get_features
tools.description: List every feature and amenity a campsite listing can have, optionally filtered by category. These are the exact names search_campsites accepts in its features filter.

tools.name: get_accommodation_types
tools.description: List the accommodation types offered at one listing (for example powered sites, unpowered sites, cabins or rooms), by entity_id from search_campsites. Returns pricing, capacity, amenities and vehicle access for each type.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search camping gear, outdoor products and accessories sold in the Camping Australia store, by keyword and/or product category. Returns matching products with name, brand, price, image and stock details.

tools.name: recommend_gear
tools.description: Suggest products from the Camping Australia store suited to one campsite, based on its features and type: for example fishing gear for a campsite with fishing, or recovery equipment for one with 4WD-only access. Takes the campsite's entity_id from search_campsites.

tools.name: get_weather_forecast
tools.description:
Get a daily weather forecast for a campsite or a pair of coordinates. Provide either campsite_name (a full or partial campsite name, resolved to that campsite's stored coordinates) or latitude and longitude.

Returns up to 14 days from the primary forecast provider, or about 10 days when the backup

tools.name: bk_search_operators
tools.description: Requires sign-in. Find accommodation operators near a set of coordinates that can be booked in real time, with live inventory from our booking partner. This differs from search_campsites, which searches the full Camping Australia directory, including places that cannot be booked online. Returns each

tools.name: bk_operator_availability
tools.description: Requires sign-in. Get live products, prices and availability at one bookable operator for specific dates and party size. operator_id comes from bk_search_operators; check_in and check_out are YYYY-MM-DD dates. Returns bookable products with product_id, price, max_guests and an available flag (or, fo

tools.name: bk_cart_add
tools.description:
Requires sign-in and the booking:cart permission. Add a product to the live booking cart, or answer a question the park asks while adding it.
- First add: omit session_key to open a new cart, and pass operator_id, product_id, check_in, check_out, adults, children and quoted_price (the price from bk_

tools.name: bk_cart_checkout
tools.description:
Requires sign-in and the booking:checkout permission. Finalise the live booking cart in two steps:
1. Without confirm, it returns the booking summary (property, dates, guests) and total price, with no payment link.
2. With confirm=true, it returns a single link to the park's secure payment page cove

tools.name: bk_cart_guest
tools.description: Requires sign-in and the booking:cart permission. Set the lead guest's contact details on the live booking cart; a name and email are needed before checkout. For a signed-in customer, any of first_name, surname and email left out are filled from their Camping Australia account, and explicit values o

tools.name: bk_cart_promo
tools.description: Requires sign-in and the booking:cart permission. Apply a promo or discount code to the live booking cart, or remove one with remove=true. A code applied before bk_cart_checkout is reflected in the checkout total. Returns the updated cart.

tools.name: bk_search_content
tools.description: Requires sign-in. Search curated tourism content (attractions, things to do, local experiences and events) from our booking partner, for questions such as what's on near a place. This content is not part of the campsite directory; accommodation is searched with bk_search_operators. Returns the match

tools.name: search_campervans
tools.description: Search live campervan and motorhome hire availability and prices for an Australian pickup city and travel dates (pickup_date and dropoff_date in YYYY-MM-DD format). This is vehicle rental; search_campsites finds places to stay. Returns matching vehicles with brand, name, category, sleeps and seats,

tools.name: get_campervan_booking_link
tools.description: Get a link for completing a campervan or motorhome hire for an Australian pickup city and dates, without running a search first. The hire is booked and paid on the rental partner's website; this connector takes no payment. Returns a single booking_url. Australia only.

tools.name: list_ride_routes
tools.description: Requires sign-in and the routes:read permission. List the traveller's saved ride routes (GPX tracks) with name, distance, point count, whether it is a loop, and start and finish. Returns the routes, newest first.

tools.name: get_ride_route
tools.description: Requires sign-in and the routes:read permission. Get one saved ride route by route_id: summary, a simplified preview line as [lat, lng] pairs, waypoints, and gpx_download_url, a link to the full GPX file that expires in 15 minutes.

tools.name: import_ride_route
tools.description: Requires sign-in and the routes:write permission. Save a GPX file to the traveller's ride routes. Pass the file contents as text in gpx (up to 64 KB) and an optional name. Returns the saved route, or duplicate=true if the same file is already saved.

tools.name: delete_ride_route
tools.description: Requires sign-in and the routes:write permission. Delete one saved ride route by route_id. The route is removed from the traveller's library and cannot be fetched again.
